Norms¶

Torch-inspired norms are available as Series methods:

  • x.norm(p=2)

  • x.norm(p, dim, keepdim=false)

Supported:

  • p = 1, 2, +inf

  • general p for real floating types (implemented via abs/pow/sum)

Notes:

  • Complex norms are not implemented yet in this patch.
